name: Mild steel mail aventail
description: A broad curtain of mild steel rings laced to a helmet's rim, hanging over the face, neck and shoulders. Soft steel, roughly made, but it still turns a blade.
notes: Laid out flat, outside up, front on +z: a 600 mm crescent of rings round a 200 mm head opening, its inner edge sewn to a brown leather band pierced with 13 lacing holes, open at the back with two tie thongs. Rings show as raised rows running round the curtain. Mail in `steel-mail`, dull rings for the mild grade. A heap would not read as a curtain, so the mail is laid out flat. It covers the shoulders too. The xl and xs sizes share the model. It mounts on a helmet, so it `fits` `helmet` and its `wearable` has no slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Mild steel half mask
description: A plain plate of mild steel that hooks onto a cap helmet and guards the jaw and mouth. A rough copy of a finer piece, with nothing to spare for looks.
notes: Standing on its chin edge, front on +z: a plate 190 mm across and 128 mm tall at the nose ridge, curving back to the ears, with rolled edges, seven breathing slots and hinged hooks at the upper corners. Plate in `steel-bright`, the mild grade, with no ornament. A curved plate fills little of its box. The xl and xs sizes share the model. It mounts on a helmet, so it `fits` `helmet` and its `wearable` has no slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Night-vision monocular (on)
description: A single-tube night-vision scope on a helmet arm, switched on. It turns the dark a grainy green across a narrow view, and drains its battery while it runs.
notes: Lying on its belly, objective on +z: a dark tube 176 mm long with the mount, a wide objective with a ribbed focus ring at the front, a rubber eyecup at the back with the display glowing green, a lit green lamp on top, a battery tube along the right side and a J-arm over the top ending in the dovetail shoe for a helmet mount. This is the switched-on state; the unlit item has its own model, and switching between them waits on Deadvox item states. Its sight should follow the `nightVision` block of https://github.com/roobie/skelly, `packages/deadvox/src/content/base/items-tools.libsonnet`, `night_vision_goggles`, with a narrower field, and it takes a battery as those goggles do. It mounts on a helmet, so it `fits` `helmet` and its `wearable` has no slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Cutting outsert lens
description: A dark green shade lens that clips over a gas mask's single eyepiece, guarding the eyes from a cutting torch's glare and from flying chips. Hard to see through for anything else.
notes: Standing on its lower edge, front on +z: a thin curved shield 172 mm across and 90 mm tall in `glass-lens-green`, the nearest see-through green shade, with black clip tabs at its ends, top and foot. A thin curved lens fills almost none of its box. It brings glare protection, which Deadvox has no rule for yet. It clips over a full-face gas mask's eyepiece, so it `fits` `mask_lens` and its `wearable` has no slot. Tiles draw the lens opaque; it stays see-through in the game. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
